blocks.text: Percentage uncertainties add ki jati hain. Example: ek conductor ki resistance R us par lagaye gaye potential difference V aur us mein behne wale current I se nikalti hai. R mein maximum (zyada se zyada) uncertainty yun nikalein:

• Addition aur subtraction (jama aur tafreeq) ke liye:
Absolute uncertainties add karein.
• Multiplication aur division (zarb aur taqseem) ke liye:
Percentage uncertainties add karein.
• Power factor ke liye:
Power factor × percentage uncertainty.
blocks.title: Thumb Rule for Total Uncertainty
bold: Addition aur subtraction (jama aur tafreeq) ke liye
Multiplication aur division (zarb aur taqseem) ke liye

blocks.text_alt: Percentage uncertainty in V = (0.1 V / 3.4 V) × 100 = 3%
Percentage uncertainty in I = (0.05 A / 0.68 A) × 100 = 7%

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab I ki percentage uncertainty ke fraction ke upar 0.5 A chhapti hai. Current ki absolute uncertainty 0.05 A hai (I = 0.68 ± 0.05 A), is liye sahi calculation (0.05 A / 0.68 A) × 100 ≈ 7% hai; kitab ka answer 7% bhi isi ke mutabiq hai.
Is liye R ki total percentage uncertainty 3 + 7 = 10% hai.
10% of 5.0 = 0.5, is liye R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm likha jata hai. Uncertainty sirf estimate (andaza) hai, is liye use ek significant figure tak likhte hain.

blocks.caption: Travel time of light (roshni ke safar ka time) (For your information)

blocks.text: Kitab Moon (chand) se Earth tak roshni ka time 1 min 20 s likhti hai. Chand taqreeban 3.84 × 10⁸ m door hai aur roshni ki speed 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ hai, is liye time = (3.84 × 10⁸ m) / (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) ≈ 1.3 s hai, ek minute se zyada nahi.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Pluto aur Earth ka distance badalta rehta hai, is liye Pluto se roshni aane ka time taqreeban 4 se 7 ghante ke darmiyan rehta hai; kitab ka 5 h 20 s ek rough estimate (mota andaza) hai.
